text.p: Shipping and transport companies Malaysian International Shipping Corp Bhd, Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd and PNSL Holdings Bhd were requoted on Tuesday, despite ongoing negotiations for a stake purchase.
At 0217 GMT, the three companies were down between 1.30 ringgit and 2.40 ringgit.

Konsortium had said on July 11 that it had received approval from the central bank to start negotiating for a 29.35 percent stake in Malaysian International Shipping, currently held by state pension fund Kumpulan Wang Amanah Pencen.
PNSL is an associate company of Konsortium.

"We write to inform that Konsortium and PNSL are still pursuing negotiations to acquire an interest in the 29.35 percent stake in Malaysia International Shipping Corp Bhd," said Konsortium in a statement released on Tuesday.
Konsortium said it and PNSL were in the "final stages of the joint restructuring," to rationalise Malaysia's transport industry, and would "explore opportunities to work with MISC.
